tools.name: search_products_and_services
tools.description: Searches iEscrow's public catalog of physical products and services sold for crypto, with the seller's REAL reputation on each result (identity verified, completed trades, success and dispute rates, star rating). No account needed. Filter by text, price range in USD, category, condition, country it

tools.name: get_product_or_service
tools.description: Full detail of one listing from search_products_and_services plus a quote: how much crypto a buyer would lock to buy it right now (price in USD converted at the current rate, plus iEscrow's standard fee) and how long the seller has to deliver before the escrow releases by itself. No account needed.

tools.name: get_seller_profile
tools.description: The real track record of an iEscrow account: completed trades, cancellations at fault, dispute rate, average star rating and whether their identity is verified. Use the seller.user_id from search_products_and_services. No account needed. There is no invented score: what you get is what happened.
